csv_project_name: DB for Parking Shades & Reconfigure Parking Lots
csv_scope_of_work: The scope of this project shall provide complete design services to deliver a comprehensive solution by using parking lot improvement documents (see Section 10.0 Reference Material), engineering calculations, and preparation of construction documents compliant with OSHA, OHS, and VA Master Specifications as basis of design to reduce vehicle-pedestrian conflicts, enhance accessibility, and protect Veterans and staff from extreme heat, supporting VA s mission to provide a safe, accessible, and comfortable healthcare environment. The Design Build (DB) Contractor shall provide all Architect Engineer (A/E) design services, labor, materials, equipment, supplies, investigations, and professional supervision necessary to develop and deliver the complete design. The Contractor shall also furnish all required construction period services in support of this contract. Design must meet Veterans Affairs Design Guides and Design Criteria and Veterans Affairs Master Specifications at the technical information library
